title: The Chrome Gospel
author: Barış Kısır
premise: In a flooded Neo-Kolkata, memory broker Alia Sen sells other people's pasts until a gig forces her to install a client's memory of a murder she did not commit. To survive the corporation that framed her, Alia must trace the chrome chip through the city's data-sea.
long_description: 2089 Neo-Kolkata. Memory broker Alia Sen takes a routine transfer gig and ends up with a memory of committing murder. Framed by Ereshkigal Corp, she traces the chip through the Data-Sea with ex-constable Rakesh and chip-surgeon Vada, broadcasts the true memory, and donates her first honest memory to the Dead Choir.
main_characters: Alia Sen — memory broker, cynical, secretly principled
Rakesh — ex-constable with a stolen badge
Vada — chip-surgeon, sardonic, addicted to reading memories
the Dead Choir — monks who collect memory-donations
